snippet.title: Tales of Tuscany - Launch Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Tales of Tuscany is out February 2nd, 2027 - My next RPG which is a refreshed and more modular take on the Athenian Rhapsody Format. Not a sequel. Equally enjoyable for those who have NOT played Athenian Rhapsody. 

It'll be out on PC, Switch, PlayStation, Xbox, GameSphere, iOS and Android on that date.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3334170/Tales_of_Tuscany/

Athenian Rhapsody - A choose your own adventure Motherlike RPG on PC, Consoles, and Mobile. Very funny good game ngl:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1671720/Athenian_Rhapsody/

Check out all of my other content and links here: https://beacons.ai/athenianrhapsody
